nodes.label: Prefer Statically Analyzable Paths
nodes.rationale: Hiding a path inside a variable forces the bundler to include every possible file or widen Next.js output file tracing, costing larger server bundles, slower builds, worse cold starts and more memory. Same rule for import() specifiers and for fs paths built from process.cwd(): use an explicit map of import thunks, or make each final path literal at the callsite.

edges.source_location: constrains how the import() specifiers used for code splitting must be written for the bundler to narrow the chunk set
both attack the same root cause - an over-wide module graph the bundler must analyze - one via unanalyzable paths, the other via mass re-exports; both cite slower builds and worse cold starts
